component.name: LGL Papercutter
component.summary: Compose wallpapers for your desktop resolution

description.p: LGL Papercutter provides a visual, local workflow for positioning, resizing, and fitting wallpapers to a chosen display resolution.

Migrates to GTK 4 for better theming and a better look on GTK desktops. Papercutter now follows the desktop GTK theme live, including its colour palette, light or dark mode, accent colour, and fonts, and has a redesigned window with queue thumbnails and settings cards.

Adds per-image output quality with an estimated output size, editable image metadata, a zoom Reset button, a 5120x1440 preset, and gap-aware export numbering. Defaults to the primary monitor and keeps indexed PNG exports compact.
Adds comprehensive in-app Help and an About dialog with project, author, license, and donation information.
Adds non-destructive batch exports, numbered output planning, itemised save previews, and independently staged target resolutions.
Initial release with visual wallpaper composition, resolution presets, verified backups, Save As, and in-app restoration.
